title: data of sapu rules status, install and reset --json
description: The rules in use after the command. install and reset return the same shape as status.

source.description: embedded: the rules built into this Sapu. bundle: a signed rule update installed with sapu rules install

version.description: Version of the rules in use, dotted numbers like 2026.11.20

embedded_version.description: Version of the rules built into this Sapu

created.description: Bundle only: when the update was made

min_sapu.description: Bundle only: the oldest Sapu that may use it

file.description: Bundle only: where the update is stored

warning.description: Why an installed update is not used (changed after install, bad signature, rules this Sapu cannot load, older than the built-in rules). Sapu then uses the built-in rules.

key_configured.description: This build has a signing key, so it can install updates
